name: HYDRA-UMC-DETECTION-HEF
build: Requires Hailo runtime/SDK on the real CM5 for the compilation toolchain itself (ONNX export, Dataflow Compiler, HEF packaging); the model registry (registry.py) needs neither.
notes: Functional v0: real compiled-model registry - JSON schema validation, duplicate-version detection, latest-version lookup by name/task, and sha256 checksum verification against local files, exposed via 'registry validate'/'registry latest'. 21 tests. The ONNX/Dataflow-Compiler/HEF toolchain that would populate the registry still needs real Hailo hardware and is future work.
